status.note: The status page fills in with JavaScript, so it was read in a browser; Hyperbolic's blog lists no acquisition of the company, and its latest company news is the October 2026 Series A1.

retention.value: Not stored or retained after the request is completed
retention.quote: This data is used solely for the purpose of processing your request and is never stored or retained after the task is completed.
retention.note: The privacy policy says that if you rate an output, the related conversation is stored as feedback; Hyperbolic's Flux post says some models are routed to third-party providers, whose retention the pages read do not describe.

zdr.quote: Once the inference process is complete, the data is immediately discarded.
zdr.note: The pages read do not use the term zero data retention; the value rests on this sentence. The privacy policy says a conversation is stored as feedback if you rate an output, and the Flux post says some models are routed to third-party providers.

zdr_how.quote: Input data is collected solely for the purpose of completing the specific AI inference task and is not stored, retained, or used beyond this process.

training.quote: For the avoidance of doubt, Hyperbolic does not use any of your User Content, including Inputs or Outputs, to train any generative artificial intelligence models.
training.note: The terms add that third-party AI tools made available through the service may use or train on inputs and outputs under their own terms.

soc2.quote: Hyperbolic has completed a SOC 2 Type I audit and a SOC 2 Type II engagement is underway.
soc2.note: Type II is in progress; the docs say reports are available under NDA.

attestations.note: The security page says "Hyperbolic is not currently HIPAA-certified." and offers data processing agreements on request; the trust centre lists only SOC 2.

subprocessors.note: The page is a list of 8 names with no sentences; it does not name the third-party model providers that Hyperbolic's Flux post says some requests are routed to.

regions.note: Hyperbolic's Flux post (https://www.hyperbolic.ai/blog/flux-inference-api) says "The current edge is in us-west-2.", which is where the API edge runs; the pages read do not say where inference runs.

funding.quote: We’re announcing $30 million in Series A1 funding led by Walden Catalyst, the venture capital firm founded by Intel CEO Lip-Bu Tan and former Samsung Electronics Corporate President and CSO Young Sohn.
